title: Hole test coupon
prompt: Test coupon to check how my printer does holes: a 120 × 40 × 10 mm plate centred on the origin (Z = 0 to 10) with four holes on the centre line, 30 mm apart, from left to right: a plain 5 mm through hole, an M3 socket-head hole counterbored to the ISO 4762 size, an M4 flat-head hole countersunk to the ISO 10642 size, and a hole for a standard M3 heat-set insert. All from the top. Make every hole a hole feature, with the presets for the M3 and M4 ones.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
One M3 ISO 4762 counterbored hole (Ø3.4, counterbore Ø6.5 × 3.4)
One standard M3 heat-set insert hole (Ø4 × 6.7)
Left to right: plain, counterbore, countersink, insert
The counterbore, countersink and insert hole all open in the top face (a plain through hole has no side)

notes: Values from the SPEC-v1 §6.5 HOLE_SIZES table: M3 counterbore Ø6.5 × 3.4 over Ø3.4; M4 countersink Ø9.18 × 90° over Ø4.5; M3 insert Ø4.0 × 6.7. Construction: cbore, csink, insert read the hole features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only those tests.
